(+)-Sativene synthase
(EC 4.2.3.129,
cop4
) is an
enzyme
with
systematic name
(2
E
,6
E
)-farnesyl-diphosphate diphosphate-lyase (cyclizing, (+)-sativene-forming)
.
[
1
]
[
2
]
[

]
This enzyme
catalyses
the following
chemical reaction
(2
E
,6
E
)-farnesyl diphosphate
⇌
{\displaystyle \rightleftharpoons }
(+)-sativene +
diphosphate
This enzyme is isolated from the
fungus
Coprinus cinereus
.
